description: This file defines a React functional component 'Layout' that provides the application’s main layout structure including header, sidebar navigation, and main content area. It uses React Router's NavLink for navigation and consumes a shared state via the useStore hook to conditionally render certain navigation links based on feature flags.

methods.name: Layout({ children })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the application's layout including header, sidebar with links (conditional on feature flags), and main content.
